summary: Millicom International Cellular S.A. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026, along with its Q2 2026 earnings release and a press release. The filing is a routine periodic report under the Luxembourg Transparency Law and SEC rules for foreign private issuers. It contains forward-looking statements and financial results but does not disclose any special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, tender offer, or management change. As a routine interim financial report, this filing does not constitute a special-situations category.
